tools.name: search_startups
tools.description: Search the Salesbook Top-100 corpus by keyword (name, problem, solution). Returns a short text list of ranked matches. Sector is optional: omit it to search all sectors (retail, manufacturing, healthcare, education, horizontal).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Full evidence-graded startup profile: identity, problem, solution, stage, team, buyer-fit score. Every field carries source, date, and confidence. Profiles are AI-researched from public sources; founders review and correct low-confidence fields.

tools.name: get_tombstones
tools.description: Deal tombstones for a startup: dated, sourced public claims of enterprise commercial wins, graded T1 (contract/rollout) to T4 (logo wall). Default confidence is claimed-unverified; F500-confirmed records are marked corroborated.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Top-100 ranking for a sector and period, with per-startup scores and the methodology version used.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: The published ranking methodology: weights, tombstone tier definitions, confidence labels, and honesty guarantees. Versioned; every ranking cites its methodology version.
